{{Top|leg}}
The '''Osaji Syndicate''' was a criminal organization that was ran by the [[Osaji family]]. It operated around the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and was involved in various illegal activities, including cut-rate shipping operations, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and gun-running.
